title: Discovering Domain-Adaptive Multimodal Design Principles Through Computational Systematic Review

contributions.purpose: 揭示最优多模态组合随学科而变
contributions.mechanism: Claude Sonnet 4对75篇研究做效应量对比(领域匹配vs通用设计)
contributions.source_quote: domain-specific approaches showing 22-65% larger effect sizes than universal designs

contributions.purpose: 揭示时序整合策略依内容复杂度反转
contributions.mechanism: 对比同时vs顺序呈现在高/低复杂度下的效应量
contributions.evaluation: 高复杂度顺序呈现 d=0.59 vs 同时 0.28(+111%);低复杂度反之
contributions.source_quote: high-complexity content benefits from sequential rather than simultaneous presentation

contributions.purpose: 提出个体差异自适应框架
contributions.mechanism: 对比设计是否匹配学习者特征的效应量
contributions.source_quote: demonstrating 27-61% improvement when multimodal design matches learner characteristics

self_declared_provenance.quote: These findings challenge the current universal application of multimedia learning principles and provide the first systematic evidence for personalized multimodal learning frameworks.
